data.description:
## Description

Create YAML corpus files in plugins/dso/data/ui-reference/patterns/ covering Brignull dark patterns, AidUI taxonomy, cognitive load checklists, defensive design, and principles.design entries. Update _index.yaml and docs/ui-reference-sources.yaml.

## testing_mode
GREEN

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] YAML files created in plugins/dso/data/ui-reference/patterns/ for: Brignull dark pattern taxonomy (>=12 named patterns, paraphrase/attribution from deceptive.design), AidUI 27-class taxonomy (MIT, from SageSELab/AidUI), cognitive load checklist, defensive design checklist, representative entries from benbrignell/principles.design (MIT)
- [ ] Each file has: rule_id, prior_art (source URL), precedence, domain: patterns, license
- [ ] Summary + Detail tiers populated; no file exceeds 500 lines
- [ ] Brignull content uses paraphrase with attribution if verbatim copying not permitted; AidUI uses MIT license attribution
- [ ] principles.design entries are representative subset (not full catalog) per MIT license
- [ ] check-corpus-schema passes on all new patterns/ files
- [ ] ref-query returns >=1 result for query 'dark patterns' with domain: patterns
- [ ] _index.yaml updated with all new entries
- [ ] docs/ui-reference-sources.yaml updated with: deceptive.design, SageSELab/AidUI, benbrignell/principles.design
- [ ] All tests in test_corpus_patterns_dark.py pass (GREEN)

## Story DD Coverage
- DD1: patterns/ covers all 4 required taxonomies, Summary+Detail, <=500 lines
- DD2: _index.yaml updated, schema valid
- DD3: ref-query returns results for 'dark patterns'

## Files to Modify
- plugins/dso/data/ui-reference/patterns/brignull-dark-patterns.yaml [CREATE]
- plugins/dso/data/ui-reference/patterns/aidui-taxonomy.yaml [CREATE]
- plugins/dso/data/ui-reference/patterns/cognitive-load-checklist.yaml [CREATE]
- plugins/dso/data/ui-reference/patterns/defensive-design-checklist.yaml [CREATE]
- plugins/dso/data/ui-reference/patterns/principles-design-entries.yaml [CREATE]
- plugins/dso/data/ui-reference/_index.yaml [UPDATE]
- docs/ui-reference-sources.yaml [UPDATE]
